title: Adverbial clause of reason and result

atoms.text:
Der adverbial clause of reason gibt an, warum die im Hauptsatz beschriebene Handlung stattfindet.
Er kann durch verschiedene Konjunktionen eingeleitet werden, zum Beispiel:
atoms.sound: Der <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>adverbial clause of reason</voice> gibt an, warum die im Hauptsatz beschriebene Handlung stattfindet. Er kann durch verschiedene Konjunktionen eingeleitet werden, zum Beispiel<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>because, since</voice> und <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>as</voice>

hint.text: Adverbial clause of reason – Adverbialsatz des Grundes
hint.sound: <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>Adverbial clause of reason</lang> bedeutet Adverbialsatz des Grundes.
hint.label: Adverbial clause of reason

example.a: We will watch the film <m-yellow>because it has great reviews</m-yellow>.
example.b: Wir werden uns den Film anschauen, weil er tolle Rezensionen hat.
example.sound: We will watch the film because it has great reviews.

instruction.text: Setze die passenden Konjunktionen für die adverbial clauses of reason ein.
instruction.sound: Setze die passenden Konjunktionen für die <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>adverbial clauses of reason</voice> ein.

atoms.b: My friend asked me why I want to become a songwriter, but not a singer. The answer is pretty clear. I'm not interested in performing my own songs, ((++as so)) I don't have a nice singing voice. ((++Since When)) I don't like to be in the spotlight, I'm not sad about it either. I just want to write songs ((++because therefore)) I love music and I want to create some too.

atoms.text:
Der adverbial clause of result gibt an, was aufgrund der im Hauptsatz beschriebenen Handlung passiert.
Er kann durch verschiedene Konjunktionen eingeleitet werden, zum Beispiel:
atoms.sound: Der <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>adverbial clause of result</voice> gibt an, was aufgrund der im Hauptsatz beschriebenen Handlung passiert. Er kann durch verschiedene Konjunktionen eingeleitet werden, zum Beispiel <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>such that, so that</voice> und <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>that</voice>

hint.text: Adverbial clause of result – Adverbialsatz der Folge
hint.sound: <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>Adverbial clause of result</lang> bedeutet Adverbialsatz der Folge.
hint.label: Adverbial clause of result

example.a: She swam so fast <m-yellow>that she won the swimming competition</m-yellow>.
example.b: Sie ist so schnell geschwommen, dass sie den Schwimmwettbewerb gewonnen hat.
example.sound: She swam so fast that she won the swimming competition.

instruction.text: Tippe in jedem Satz auf den adverbial clause of result.
instruction.sound: Tippe in jedem Satz auf den <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>adverbial clause of result</voice>

atoms.sound: She gave such a good speech that the teacher was amazed.

atoms.b: She_explained_it_so_well ((that her classmates understood the topic)).
atoms.sound: She explained it so well that her classmates understood the topic.

atoms.b: Her_arguments_were_valid ((so that no one could disagree)).
atoms.sound: Her arguments were valid so that no one could disagree.

atoms.b: The_audience_listened_so_carefully ((that she felt really comfortable speaking)).
atoms.sound: The audience listened so carefully that she felt really comfortable speaking.

atoms.b: The_day_before, she_had_practised_her_presentation_in_front_of_the_mirror ((so that she wouldn't forget her text)).
atoms.sound: The day before, she had practised her presentation in front of the mirror so that she wouldn't forget her text.
